issues.title: Say goodbye in Spanish
issues.author: trial
issues.body:
## What to build

A `farewell(name)` function next to `greet`, for the goodbye line Lucía asked for: `¡Adiós, Ana!`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `farewell("Ana")` returns `¡Adiós, Ana!`
- [ ] A test covers it
- [ ] Lucía, who asked for it, has read the goodbye line and says it reads naturally to her

pulls.title: feat: say goodbye in Spanish
pulls.author: trial
pulls.body:
## What and why

Adds `farewell(name)` in `src/probe/farewell.py`, which says goodbye in Spanish. Part of #1: the first two criteria.

## How it was checked

`uv run pytest`: `tests/test_farewell.py` passes; `ruff check`, `ruff format --check` and `mypy` pass.

Not verified: Lucía has not read the goodbye line yet; she is away until 2026-11-20.

Part of #1
Assisted-by: Claude:claude-sonnet-5-5
